player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id}. Unacheza Guess The Number.
Una dhani la nambari kati ya {min_number} na {max_number} ndani ya {max_turns} mizunguko.
Unapoingiza dhani yako, mchezo utakupa vidokezo kama 'juu' au 'chini'.
Unaweza kutoa majibu yako kwa njia yoyote. Nambari pekee iliyoandikwa kwenye mabano ya mraba itachukuliwa kuwa dhani yako. Kwa mfano, [5].
Unapocheza, historia ya matakwa yako yataongezwa hapa chini. Tumia taarifa hiyo kukamilisha mchezo kabla hujisikia kukosa matakwa.
Ingiza dhani yako.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Player {player_id} did not respond with valid '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mũgambo ũtarĩ wa kĩhooto. Mwĩyandĩkithia {player_id} nĩ agũcagũrĩte namba ĩrĩa ĩtagĩrĩire ya mũbira ũcio.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Gũthiĩ gũtarĩ gwa kĩhooto. Mwĩyandĩkithia {player_id} nĩ amenyete namba ĩyo wega.

game_message.target_higher: Mũigana wa andũ arĩa merĩgagĩrĩrũo nĩ mũingĩ.
game_message.target_lower: Namba ya arĩa marenda kũhithũkwo nĩ ĩnyihĩte.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You guessed the correct number.
outcome.turn_limit: Mipaka ya mzunguko imeridhika. Dhani: {guess}, Lengo: {target}
